sentences.text: Rule nineteen is one of the most important and most tested rules, and it’s often misunderstood.
It applies to vessels not in sight of one another when navigating in or near an area of restricted visibility.
You may be in clear weather beside a fog bank.
Under Rule nineteen there is no stand-on vessel and no give-way vessel.
The steering rules for vessels in sight don’t apply.
Every vessel has the same duty to avoid a close-quarters situation, and every vessel must take action.
